statement: N-0081 distributor channel and New-DAP price protection. Questions: (1) the waterfall steps for a distributor deal (rebate, disti margin, in what order and on which base); (2) how New-DAP price protection is paid: credit note per unit of distributor stock on hand at the change date, or re-invoice; (3) which stock counts: DSI stock on hand at the change date, or stock bought in the last N days. Evidence: spec section 9.1; DSI SOH has no cost column today. Reversibility: medium. Resolving step: Warren walks one real price-directive example through the steps.
